text_block_list.text:
Gazing out the window, I caught sight of
Agnes Digital sprinting through the rain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Here we go, one more laaaaaap!
Thirty minutes later――while walking down the hallway...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Phew, what a run that was.
choice_data_list: Thanks for your hard work in the rain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My, look who it is...
Hehehe, how soft! But that's exactly why♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
According to the forecast, it's gonna rain on my race day too!
So I figured it'd be best to practice in the same conditions!
choice_data_list: Push yourself too hard and you'll catch a cold.
Push yourself too hard and you'll catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
According to the forecast, it's gonna rain on my race day too!
So I figured it'd be best to practice in the same conditions!
choice_data_list: Push yourself too hard and you'll catch a cold.
Push yourself too hard and you'll catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Non-non♪ Rain, rough tracks, even a cold—
nothing can stop Digi-tan's passion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Besides, rain or shine, we run on dirt!
There's no harm in getting some practice in, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, no matter the dirt track conditions, I'll never miss the optimal moment~♪
Indeed, training in poor conditions should make it easier to adapt to any situation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I never want to cut any corners, after all...!
Intense passion burned clearly within her gleaming eyes. Stoically chasing victory, she is the very model of an Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
!
I'll devote myself to spotting pure perfection, no matter how harsh the environment♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume running through the pouring rain...
Covered in mud and tangled in raw emotion toward one anotherâ

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!! A heavy☆romance unfolding
across heavy turf!! Simply irresistible~♪
